QuestInfo.name: Tread Carefully in the Back Yard
QuestInfo.0: Limbert has a chore for you.
QuestInfo.1: Limbert wants you to gather some Eggs from the chicken coop in the Back Yard. He warned you not to stress out Bigby, his pet, in the process. Bigby's a mean one, with actual wolf blood flowing through his veins...
